title: Protocollo N 2014 - Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
official: Studio Osservazionale Sulla qualità di Vita di Pazienti Affetti da IPB in Terapia Medica e/o Sottoposti a Intervento Chirurgico
summary: Prospective observational study on the quality of life of patients with BPH under medical therapy and/or undergoing surgery.

interventions.name: Observation of patients with a benign prostatic hyperplasia condition

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* subjects suffering from benign prostatic hyperplasia undergoing medical therapy and/or undergoing surgery
* subjects \>= 18 years old
* signature of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* subjects \< 18 years
* presence of mental or physical disability that may prevent the patient from answering the questionnaires.
